about: Print the electronic entry permit given on arrival to citizens of certain countries.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Printout of tourism entry permit on arrival. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For nationals of certain countries who received an entry permit on arrival in the UAE
documents: No documents needed unless ICP cannot fetch your data from government records
timing: The page gives no processing time
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
